title: Skill Metadata — Tier 1 (Full)
description: Full 5-goal metadata for the Skill tool (skill invocation). The skill name is the primary KOTH signal. koth.agents_in_options should contain the skill being invoked (using skill FQN format). Oracle should be consulted when multiple skills could satisfy the request.

notes.koth.agents_in_options: Skill FQN being invoked (e.g., 'feature-dev:feature-dev'). Single-element when no choice was made.
notes.koth.oracle_consulted: Set true when Oracle was queried to select between competing skills.
notes.source: Format: 'main:orchestrator' or 'agent:{agent_type}' depending on what invoked the skill.
